_**User**_

@engineering-frontend-developer

I am building an internal ops monitoring dashboard for a clinical system 
called Unity. The backend API is running at the URL in NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.

Tech stack: Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. No UI libraries.

PROJECT STRUCTURE:
/frontend
  app/
    page.tsx          (main dashboard, 'use client')
    layout.tsx
  components/
    TopBar.tsx        (title, filters, refresh button, countdown timer)
    TabNav.tsx        (tab switcher)
    overview/
      MetricCards.tsx
      CentreTable.tsx
      ActivityChart.tsx   (Chart.js bar chart: events by centre)
      EventTypeChart.tsx  (Chart.js donut: breakdown by event type)
    clinicians/
      ClinicianChart.tsx  (Chart.js horizontal bar, split bars per metric)
      ClinicianTable.tsx
    managers/
      ManagerChart.tsx
      ManagerTable.tsx
    monitoring/
      DayPicker.tsx
      MonitoringCards.tsx
      UserStatusTable.tsx
      ActivityHeatmap.tsx
      LivePulse.tsx       (pulsing green dot + "Live" text)
    bottlenecks/
      BottleneckCards.tsx
      PendingTable.tsx
  hooks/
    useOverview.ts
    useClinicians.ts
    useManagers.ts
    useMonitoring.ts
    useBottlenecks.ts
  lib/
    api.ts        (all fetch calls, typed)
    types.ts      (TypeScript interfaces matching API responses)

TYPES (lib/types.ts) — define interfaces matching the API exactly:
- OverviewData, CentreBreakdown, Centre
- Clinician
- Manager
- MonitoringUser, HeatmapEntry, MonitoringData
- BottleneckData
- ApiError

API CALLS (lib/api.ts):
Base URL from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
Functions:
- fetchOverview(centreId?, dateFrom?, dateTo?)
- fetchClinicians(centreId?, dateFrom?, dateTo?)
- fetchManagers(centreId?, dateFrom?, dateTo?)
- fetchMonitoring(date: string)
- fetchBottlenecks(centreId?, dateFrom?, dateTo?)
All return typed responses, throw on error.

HOOKS — each takes filter params, returns { data, loading, error, refetch }:
- useOverview(filters)
- useClinicians(filters)
- useManagers(filters)
- useMonitoring(date)
- useBottlenecks(filters)

TOP BAR (components/TopBar.tsx):
- Title: "Unity — clinical ops dashboard"
- Centre dropdown (populated from overview.centres)
- Date range: two date inputs (from / to)
- Refresh button (manual)
- Countdown: "Refreshing in 47s" — counts down from 60, resets on manual refresh
- Last updated: "Last updated 10:32:05"
- All filters are lifted to page.tsx as state and passed down as props

TABS: Overview | Clinicians | Centre Managers | Daily Monitoring | Bottlenecks

TAB: Overview
- 6 metric cards in a grid: Total Cases, Assessments Added, Results Generated,
  Resets (red if > 0), Transfers (amber if > 0), Active Centres
- Bar chart: events by centre (top 8)
- Donut chart: event type breakdown
- Centre breakdown table: Centre | Cases | Assessments | Results | Resets | 
  Completion %

TAB: Clinicians
Horizontal stacked bar chart (Chart.js), one row per clinician:
- Each bar split into segments: Results (blue #378ADD), Active Caseload (green 
  #1D9E75), Total Actions (amber #BA7517)
- Sort by results descending
- Star emoji on top performer row, red arrow on bottom performer
Below chart: table with columns:
Clinician | Centre | Results | Active Caseload | Total Actions | Last Activity |
Last Login | Status (Active/Inactive badge)

TAB: Centre Managers
Same chart pattern. Bar segments: Cases Registered (purple #7F77DD), 
Assessments Assigned (blue #378ADD), Total Actions (green #1D9E75)
Below: table with columns:
Manager | Role | Centre | Cases | Assessments Assigned | Total Actions | 
Last Activity | Last Login

TAB: Daily Monitoring
Top section:
- DayPicker: dropdown of availableDates from API, default to today
- LivePulse component: pulsing green dot + "Live" text + "Auto-refreshing every 
  60s"
- 4 metric cards: Total Users | Active Today | No Activity Today (red) | 
  Avg Actions per Active User

User status table — sorted active-first then by actionCount desc:
User | Role (coloured badge) | Centre | Status (green/red dot) | Actions | 
Last Action | Logged In Today (yes/no badge)

Activity Heatmap below table:
- Users on Y axis (show firstName + lastName)
- Last 30 days on X axis (show MM-DD)
- Cell background intensity by count:
  0 = bg-gray-100, 1-3 = bg-blue-200, 4-8 = bg-blue-400, 9+ = bg-blue-700
- Show count number inside cell if count > 0
- Horizontal scroll if needed

Row styling rules for user status table:
- Active users: left border green (border-l-4 border-green-400)
- No activity today: entire row text muted (text-gray-400)
- Not logged in today: show small amber badge "No login"

TAB: Bottlenecks
4 metric cards:
- Avg case onboarding turnaround (case registered → first assessment assigned)
- Pending goal approvals (red badge if > 0)
- Assessment completion rate (%)
- Cases stuck in onboarding > 48h (red if > 0)

Pending table:
Metric | Count | Status
Assessments awaiting assignment | from API | red/green badge
Goal approvals pending | from API | red/green badge
Cases stuck > 48h | from API | red/green badge
Resets this period | from API | amber badge
Transfers this period | from API | amber badge

STYLING RULES:
- Tailwind only, no inline styles, no CSS files
- Role badges: Clinician = blue, Centre Manager = green, Super Admin = purple
- Status: active = green dot, inactive = red dot
- Numbers: red if flagged bad (resets, stuck cases), amber for warnings, 
  green for good metrics
- All charts use Chart.js loaded via CDN script tag in layout.tsx, referenced 
  via window.Chart in components

AUTO-REFRESH:
- Global interval in page.tsx, runs every 60 seconds
- Calls refetch on all active tab hooks
- CountdownTimer component shows seconds remaining
- Resets on manual refresh button click
- On Daily Monitoring tab only: also refetch monitoring data every 60s with 
  today's date

ENVIRONMENT:
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001  (dev default)

Check and follow any rules in .cursor/rules/

Here is a full summary of everything that was built:

## Unity Clinical Ops Dashboard — Frontend Implementation

**Framework**: Next.js 14 App Router · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS  
**State management**: React hooks, lifted state in `page.tsx`  
**Charts**: Chart.js 4 via CDN (`beforeInteractive` script in layout)

### File tree (33 files)

```
frontend/
├── .env.local               NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001
├── package.json / tsconfig / next.config / tailwind / postcss
├── types.d.ts               window.Chart global declaration
├── lib/
│   ├── types.ts             All TypeScript interfaces (FilterParams → BottleneckData)
│   └── api.ts               fetchOverview / fetchClinicians / fetchManagers /
│                            fetchMonitoring / fetchBottlenecks
├── hooks/
│   ├── useOverview          }
│   ├── useClinicians        } Each returns { data, loading, error, refetch }
│   ├── useManagers          } Re-fetches when filter primitives change
│   ├── useMonitoring        } via filtersRef pattern (stable doFetch, no stale closures)
│   └── useBottlenecks       }
├── app/
│   ├── layout.tsx           Chart.js CDN script + Inter font
│   └── page.tsx             Orchestrator: all state, all hooks, 60s auto-refresh,
│                            countdown timer, manual refresh, tab routing
└── components/
    ├── TopBar.tsx            Sticky header: title, centre dropdown, date range,
    │                         refresh button, countdown, last-updated
    ├── TabNav.tsx            ARIA role="tablist" tab switcher
    ├── overview/
    │   ├── MetricCards       6 cards: Cases, Assessments, Results,
    │   │                     Resets (red), Transfers (amber), Active Centres
    │   ├── ActivityChart     Stacked bar chart: top-8 centres (Cases/Assessments/Results)
    │   ├── EventTypeChart    Doughnut: 5 event types with brand colours
    │   └── CentreTable       Cases | Assessments | Results | Resets | Completion %
    ├── clinicians/
    │   ├── ClinicianChart    Horizontal stacked bar, sorted by results desc
    │   │                     Colours: Results #378ADD · Caseload #1D9E75 · Actions #BA7517
    │   └── ClinicianTable    ⭐ top performer · ↓ bottom performer · Active/Inactive badge
    ├── managers/
    │   ├── ManagerChart      Same pattern: Cases #7F77DD · Assessments #378ADD · Actions #1D9E75
    │   └── ManagerTable      Role badges (Clinician=blue, Centre Manager=green, Super Admin=purple)
    ├── monitoring/
    │   ├── LivePulse         Pulsing green dot + "Live · Auto-refreshing every 60s"
    │   ├── DayPicker         Dropdown populated from availableDates API field
    │   ├── MonitoringCards   Total Users | Active Today | No Activity (red) | Avg Actions
    │   ├── UserStatusTable   Active-first sort; green left-border for active, muted text for
    │   │                     inactive; amber "No login" badge; green/red status dot
    │   └── ActivityHeatmap   CSS grid, sticky user labels, 30-day X-axis (MM-DD),
    │                         0=gray-100 · 1-3=blue-200 · 4-8=blue-400 · 9+=blue-700
    └── bottlenecks/
        ├── BottleneckCards   Avg onboarding hours | Pending approvals (red) |
        │                     Completion rate (green ≥80%) | Stuck cases (red)
        └── PendingTable      5 rows with red/amber count badges
```

### Key behaviours
- **Auto-refresh**: single 60s `setInterval` in `page.tsx` calls all 5 `refetch()` functions via refs to avoid stale closures
- **Countdown**: separate 1s interval, resets to 60 on every refresh (auto or manual)
- **Filter changes**: hooks re-fetch automatically when `centreId`, `dateFrom`, or `dateTo` primitives change
- **Chart.js loading**: each chart component retries `window.Chart` up to 40 times (4s) at 100ms intervals as a safety net alongside `beforeInteractive`
- **Loading states**: skeleton animations on all tables and cards; spinners inside chart canvases

```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
  au.FirstName,
  au.LastName,
  au.Email,
  ar.Name  AS roleName,
  c.CentreName
FROM AdminUser au
LEFT JOIN AdminUserRole aur ON aur.UserId = au.Id

LEFT JOIN AdminUserCentre auc ON auc.AdminUserId = au.Id
LEFT JOIN Centre c            ON c.Id = auc.CentreId
```

This query joins across user roles and centres, so if Aditi is assigned to multiple centres, she appears in multiple rows.
